# ffxf_vm_ipv6_address (Resource)

Assigns and manages an additional IPv6 address on a virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_vm_ipv6_address" "example" {
  vm_id   = 123
  address = "2001:db8::42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IPv6 address inside the VM's assigned prefix.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import identifier in vm_id/address form.
